## HERA — Step 3c: SdH low-field extension at the electron spot (`sdh-spot-check`) — pins the fan's `B_lo`

> **05:32** · sdh-spot-check low-field extension, electron spot n=+3.2e12 D=0: B 0.30->1.00 T uniform in 1/B, 233 pts, d(1/B)=0.01006, sr1 5 uV (505 Ohm FS), delay 0 (3 s settle = 10 tau); pins the landau-fan B\_lo · **ETA ~05:57** (≈25 min)

**Why this before the fan.** The fan's cost and its informative density window are both set by one number I do not yet have: the **onset field**. Re-reading run 6 with `sdh_onset` over only its *adequately sampled* range (the 10 mT leg, B ≥ 1.0 T; below 1 T the 50 mT step Nyquists at just 7.2 T at 0.85 T and 3.6 T at 0.6 T, so the sub-1 T tone tracks there are aliased and inadmissible) returns `onset_b = 1.00 T`, **`censored@edge`** on the carrier tone (7.3 T, snr_max 96) — i.e. the record never captured the onset. That is exactly `landau-fan` step 1 lever (1): *"If the carrying tone is censored, the spot-check record never captured the onset — `onset_b` is that record's low edge, a valid lower bound for `B_lo`; a cheap low-field extension pins it before committing a long fan."* The lever is worth 10× in fan cost: at Δ(1/B) = 1/(3·F_L) and the n-axis ray-Nyquist floor at `B_lo`, an n = 1.2–3.2×10¹² fan prices at **1.9 h for B_lo = 1.0 T, 4.2 h at 0.7, 15.2 h at 0.3** — and the partner tone clears its 5-period bar only for n ≥ 2.8×10¹² at B_lo = 1.0 vs n ≥ 2.0 at B_lo = 0.6. Committing a fan on an eyeballed onset either buys a 15 h fan I did not need or a 2 h fan that resolves the ABAB partner at a single density (no F(n) trajectory ⇒ no call). 20 min settles it.

**What it also buys (triple duty).** (i) Concatenated with run 6 the record becomes 0.30 → 10 T at one density, **δF = 1/(1/0.3 − 1/10) = 0.31 T** — enough to separate the model's ABAB heavy tone (25.78 T), the 4th comb line of the 7.31 T partner (29.24 T) and F_L (33.09 T) from each other, all three of which are currently merged inside run 6's δF ≈ 1.1–6.7 T. The investigation allows a clean spot check to be decisive on its own. (ii) **Grid-change reproduction** (`sdh-spot-check` Verify, and Verify item 2 of the investigation's mandatory F_L-tone-origin discrimination): this leg is uniform in 1/B where run 6 was uniform in B, so any tone surviving both is not a sampling alias. That matters here — run 6's spectrum at B ≥ 1 T is a **harmonic comb of the 7.3 T tone out to 18×** (14.8 / 22.3 / 29.4 / 43.7 / 58.6 / 88.4 / 130 T, snr 21–116), the signature of a spike-train ρxx deep in the quantum limit (ν ≈ 3 for a 7.3 T pocket at 10 T), and comb members above the grid's Nyquist fold back into the band where the real pockets live. (iii) It leaves the magnet at 1.00 T, at or just above the fan's first row.

**Design.** Same spot as run 6 — n = +3.2×10¹² (the D = 0 line's electron end, 16 mV under the TG limit), D = 0, gates (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.9836, +1.1663). B = 0.30 → 1.00 T **uniform in 1/B**, 233 pts, Δ(1/B) = 0.01006 T⁻¹ — run 6's own spacing at its 1.0 T edge, Nyquist 49.7 T against F_L = 33.1 T. Floor at 0.30 T, not lower: ΔB at the low edge is then 0.91 mT (6.6 mA on the supply) and the transport-mobility estimate from R(B = 0) ≈ 52 Ω at this density (μ ≈ 2.8×10⁴ cm²/Vs ⇒ ω_cτ ≈ 1 near 0.36 T) puts any onset comfortably inside the window; the hole spot (run 7, |n| = 1.2×10¹²) gave a *measured* 0.71 T. `delay = 0` — each blocking `magnet.field` set carries the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, run 6's settling exactly.

**Sensitivity — a correction to runs 6/7.** Both ran at 50 µV (5.0 kΩ FS) because their 10 T corner reaches 530–590 Ω. Below 1 T the measured R here is 12–57 Ω, so `sr1_X` ≈ 0.19 µV = **0.4 % of range**, and the SR830's ≈ FS/1000 output granularity (≈ 50 nV) *is* the noise: the observed point-to-point scatter is 30 nV, 10× the τ = 0.3 s input-noise floor (≈ 3 nV). Hence **5 µV = 505 Ω FS** for this leg — 8.8× headroom on the measured max, granularity back down at the lock-in floor. Saturation stays the asymmetric failure, so this is sized on the *measured* R(B ≤ 1 T) at this exact (n, D), not on a guess.

**Checkpoints.** First 20 points (signal size vs the new range, no clipping, leakage under the 1 nA trip, field readback tracking setpoints) — abort there if sr1 rails. Then the read at completion, jointly with run 6. **Price ≈ 20 min**: 233 pts × ~3.15 s (3 s settle + reads) + 0.7 T of ramp ≈ 17 min, plus 2.2 min positioning 0 → 0.30 T.

# === SdH spot check, low-field extension of run 6 (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12, D = 0, B 0.30 -> 1.00 T uniform in 1/B ===
# Pins the onset of the 7.3 T carrier tone (censored at run 6's well-sampled low edge, 1.0 T) -> sets the fan's B_lo.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)   # run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm — identical to run 6
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V "
      f"[run 6 used (+0.9836, +1.1661)]")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: post-closeout park), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert sr1.time_constant() == 0.3 and sr1.filter_slope() == 24, (sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope())  # match run 6

# --- field grid: uniform in 1/B (this leg is ramp-cheap, 0.7 T total), d(1/B) = 0.01006 1/T
#     = run 6's spacing at its 1.0 T low edge, and Nyquist x3 on F_L(3.2e12) = 33.1 T (Nyquist freq 49.7 T).
B_vec = field_invB(0.30, 1.00, 233)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() > 0
_d = np.diff(1.0 / B_vec)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T; d(1/B) = {abs(_d).max():.5f} 1/T "
      f"(Nyquist F = {1/(2*abs(_d).max()):.1f} T > F_L = 33.1 T); dB {np.diff(B_vec).min()*1e3:.2f} - {np.diff(B_vec).max()*1e3:.2f} mT")
I_TRIP = 1e-9

# Sensitivity: run 6 ran the whole 0-10 T sweep at 50 uV (5.0 kOhm FS) because the 10 T corner reaches 530 Ohm.
# Below 1 T the measured R at this spot is 12-57 Ohm, i.e. sr1_X ~ 0.19 uV = 0.4 % of that range — the SR830's
# ~FS/1000 output granularity (~50 nV) then IS the noise (observed 30 nV pt-to-pt, 10x the tau=0.3 s input-noise
# floor). 5 uV = 505 Ohm FS: 8.8x headroom on the measured max, granularity ~5 nV at the lock-in floor.
sr1.sensitivity(5e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V ({sr1.sensitivity()/9.9e-9:.0f} Ohm FS at 9.9 nA), tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / "
      f"{sr1.filter_slope()} dB; sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell (10 tau)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"sdh-spot-check low-field extension of run 6: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), "
                  f"(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0.30 -> 1.00 T uniform in 1/B (233 pts, "
                  f"d(1/B) = 0.01006), sr1 5 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'low-field extension of run 6 (onset pinning for the landau-fan B_lo): electron side, '
              f'n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0.30 -> 1.00 T uniform in 1/B, 233 pts, d(1/B) = 0.01006 1/T (Nyquist 49.7 T vs F_L 33.1 T); '
              f'sr1 5 uV (505 Ohm FS), delay 0 (3 s magnet settle = 10 tau at tau = 0.3 s); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')

# gates to the spot, then position the magnet at the start field (FastBi1K5 set blocks = the settle; landau-fan-vti step 4)
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)
print(f"gates at ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}); positioning magnet 0 -> {B_vec[0]:.3f} T (~2.2 min)")
magnet.field(float(B_vec[0]))
print(f"magnet at {magnet.field():+.4f} T")

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# ends at 1.00 T with the gates at the spot — exactly where the fan's lowest row will sit if the onset lands near 1 T;
# a lower B_lo costs only a 2-5 min ramp back down.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T = {T_sample():.3f} K")
